stages.goal: Prepare the Tron1 MuJoCo model, camera settings, and NoMaD checkpoint.
Render the onboard RGB view and align it with the NoMaD observation transform.
Run NoMaD localization, goal matching, and DDPM or DDIM action sampling.
Convert the selected waypoint into wheel-legged chassis commands and safety-constrained references.
